terbaru.judul: Reservoir Computing with Evolved Critical Neural Cellular Automata

terbaru.judul: Illuminating the Three Dogmas of Reinforcement Learning under Evolutionary Light
terbaru.pelajaran: Artificial learning systems are graduating from passive learners to increasingly autonomous agents, lending pragmatic urgency to the question of what constitutes agency.

terbaru.judul: Perceptual Distortions and Autonomous Representation Learning in a Minimal Robotic System
terbaru.pelajaran: Through analysis of the robot's sensor data during random exploration, we demonstrate how a distorted perceptual space emerges.

terbaru.judul: Participatory Evolution of Artificial Life Systems via Semantic Feedback
terbaru.pelajaran: We present a semantic feedback framework that enables natural language to guide the evolution of artificial life systems.

terbaru.judul: Flow-Lenia: Emergent evolutionary dynamics in mass conservative continuous cellular automata
terbaru.pelajaran: We propose in this paper Flow-Lenia, a mass conservative extension of Lenia.

terbaru.judul: Energentic Intelligence: From Self-Sustaining Systems to Enduring Artificial Life
terbaru.pelajaran: This paper introduces Energentic Intelligence, a class of autonomous systems defined not by task performance, but by their capacity to sustain themselves through internal energy regulation.

terbaru.judul: Adaptive Exploration in Lenia with Intrinsic Multi-Objective Ranking
terbaru.pelajaran: We present experiments demonstrating the effectiveness of our multi-objective approach and emphasize that intrinsic evolution allows diverse expressions of artificial life to emerge.

terbaru.pelajaran: This paper presents a detailed case study of Spore.fun, examining agent behaviors and their evolutionary trajectories through digital ethology.

terbaru.judul: Exploring Flow-Lenia Universes with a Curiosity-driven AI Scientist: Discovering Diverse Ecosystem Dynamics
terbaru.pelajaran: We present a curiosity-driven AI scientist method for discovering system-level dynamics in Flow-Lenia, a continuous cellular automaton (CA) with mass conservation and parameter localization.
